YMCA partnered with Accenture to build a community-based model that helps refugees and displaced
people gain skills, find work, and rebuild their futures—moving from relief to long-term capability.

### How UNICEF's GenU is closing the youth skills gap

Through UNICEF’s partnership with Accenture, young people gain access to AI-powered skilling,
digital learning and entrepreneurship opportunities that connect them to employment and brighter
futures.

[
Read more
][136]

### Philipstown's wire cars go global

Philipstown’s wire car tradition is accelerating onto the global stage through immersive
storytelling, gaming and commerce—fueling opportunity and driving impact far beyond the track.

[
Read more
][137]

The leading hyperscaler replaced batch processing with an agentic model that delivers decision-ready
outputs up to 30x faster—sharpening prioritization while enabling more confident sales decisions.

enterprise to empower employees, drive innovation and accelerate the delivery of therapies to
patients.

Accenture launches Accenture Edge to help mid-market companies harness AI and reinvent how they
operate

A new business from Accenture, built to help mid-market companies adopt AI and modernize their
technology through pre-built solutions, specialist teams and leading ecosystem partnerships.

### YMCA turns crisis into capability at scale

YMCA partnered with Accenture to build a community-based model that helps refugees and displaced
people gain skills, find work, and rebuild their futures—moving from relief to long-term capability.

[
Read more
][135]

### How UNICEF's GenU is closing the youth skills gap

Through UNICEF’s partnership with Accenture, young people gain access to AI-powered skilling,
digital learning and entrepreneurship opportunities that connect them to employment and brighter
futures.

[
Read more
][136]

### Philipstown's wire cars go global

Philipstown’s wire car tradition is accelerating onto the global stage through immersive
storytelling, gaming and commerce—fueling opportunity and driving impact far beyond the track.

[
Read more
][137]

### Google Cloud reimagines lead enrichment with agentic AI

The leading hyperscaler replaced batch processing with an agentic model that delivers decision-ready
outputs up to 30x faster—sharpening prioritization while enabling more confident sales decisions.

[
Read more
][138]

### Bristol Myers Squibb scales AI to rewire everyday work

The life sciences leader is putting people at the center of its AI ambition—rewiring work across the
enterprise to empower employees, drive innovation and accelerate the delivery of therapies to
patients.

[
Read more
][139]

## Global recognition and awards

### A Leader in Reinvention

Our Chair and CEO, Julie Sweet, is No. 11 on Fortune’s Most Powerful People in Business. Every day,
Julie and our people demonstrate why Accenture is our clients’ reinvention partner of choice.

][140]

### A Great Place To Work®

We are very proud to have earned the No. 4 spot on the Great Place To Work® list of the World’s Best
Workplaces™, our highest-ever ranking on this prestigious list.

This recognition is especially meaningful because it is based on feedback from our people worldwide.

a total of 15 PCITS providers.

D&H Distributing mourns the passing of Izzy Schwab, Chairman Emeritus and a lifelong steward of
the company.

partners and communities across North America. His values continue to guide the teams at D&H.
Those wishing to share a memory or reflection are invited to visit our digital tribute wall.

sentiments will be made available.

## ** D&H Prioritizes Partners **

For more than a century, D&H has always put our partners first. To support their future growth, we
have recently expanded our dedicated sales & support teams, broadened our communities, grown our
solutions portfolio, and invested in our finance, supply chain, and marketing agency services.

**[Discover how D&H is Built for
Growth, Giving, and Generations >>][39]**

## **Honoring the Life and Legacy of Izzy Schwab **

D&H Distributing mourns the passing of Izzy Schwab, Chairman Emeritus and a lifelong steward of
the company.

Izzy's leadership, humility, and belief in people helped shape D&H into what it is today, serving
partners and communities across North America. His values continue to guide the teams at D&H.
Those wishing to share a memory or reflection are invited to visit our digital tribute wall.

[Visit Our Tribute Wall and Share Your Stories][40]

In lieu of flowers, the family has shared that those who wish to honor Izzy's memory may consider
a contribution to either of these two organizations, causes close to his heart.

Make-A-Wish
Philadelphia, Delaware & Susquehanna Valley

[Donate Here][41]

Humane Society of Harrisburg Area/Central PA

[Donate Here][42]

The family will be having a private funeral, however we also plan to host a Celebration of Life at a
future date at D&H Headquarters that will be open to friends, partners, and members of the D&H
community. For those unable to attend in person, additional ways to participate or share
sentiments will be made available.

## Our leadership

[Slava Demchuk]
Slava Demchuk

CEO, Co-founder

“I believe compliance shouldn’t slow down business growth, but instead becomes a competitive
advantage that protects companies from legal and reputational attacks. The technology we are
building prioritizes simplicity and reliability. As regulation grows more complex worldwide, our
goal is to ensure that crypto founders barely notice it.”

[Anmol Jain]
Anmol Jain

VP of Investigation

“For many criminals, crypto still feels like an easy target. They assume the money disappears once
it moves on-chain. In reality, every transaction leaves a trail. My work is about following that
trail and identifying the people behind it. At AMLBot we investigate incidents, trace stolen funds,
and build tools that help expose bad actors and shut down the networks behind them. The goal is not
just recovery — it’s making sure the ecosystem becomes harder and harder for criminals to exploit.”

# CSA and CEMENTSY

What is CSA and who is Cementsy?

 

Cementsy is a leading manufacturer of Calcium Sulfoaluminate* (CSA) cement, a specialty cement known
for its fast-setting, high early and final strength, shrinkage compensation, and long-term
resistance to freeze-thaw, seepage, sulfate, chloride, Mg²⁺, and efflorescence. Modern CSA cement
was first developed and commercialized by the China Building Materials Academy in the 1980s. Its
exceptional performance has been well-established for over 40 years.


A team of scientists and engineers, with decades of experience in CSA technology, founded Cementsy
with the goal of providing global customers with the highest quality and most advanced CSA products.
The company supplies a wide range of CSA-related solutions to meet the needs of customers of all
sizes and specializations.


Common applications where Cementsy CSA provide substantial benefits are:


   • Rapid Concrete Repair
   • Self-Leveling Mortar
   • Self-Compacting Concrete
   • Precast and Prestressed Concrete
   • Rapid Demolding Concrete
   • Fiber Reinforced Concrete
   • Decorative Concrete
   • Shotcrete and Gunite
   • Mining and Tunneling Support
   • Coating Mortar
   • Waterproofing Mortar
   • Hydraulic Cement
   • Tile Adhesive
   • Tile Grout
   • Anchoring Grout
   • Pressure and Compacting Grout
   • Soil Stabilization
   • 3D Concrete Printing
   • Time-Sensitive Project
   • Low-Temperature Project
   • Coastal and Undersea Project

   • Portland Cement Accelerator

   • General Crack Prevention

   • Jointless Long-Span Concrete


* Also known as Calcium Sulphoaluminate


Our mission

 

At Cementsy, our mission is to increase recognition and understanding of CSA cement globally, making
it a more widely used and appreciated material in the industry and contributing to a more
sustainable future.

 

As a cement produced with 35% lower CO₂ emissions, CSA cement offers numerous performance advantages
over OPC and other Alternative Cementitious Materials (ACMs). However, despite these advantages and
its long service life, CSA cement is not widely used due to a lack of understanding in the global
market about its properties. Confusion often arises from the similarities between CSA ground
clinker, CSA binder, CSA cement, and Calcium Aluminate Cement (CAC). To address these challenges,
Cementsy partners with one of the largest CSA research institutes to spread knowledge about the
latest research and promote the global use of CSA cement.

 

Our specialties

 

Cementsy offers a variety of CSA-related products to serve customers of all sizes, including:

   • CSA Ground Clinker (CSA Binder)

   • CSA Cement

   • CSA Expansive Additive

   • CSA-Based Mortar

   • Specialized Additives and Auxiliaries for CSA Products


At Cementsy, we also offer comprehensive technical support to all of our customers, covering a range
of services, such as:

   • Reviewing formulas
   • Recommending material selection
   • Providing technical and design consultation
   • Performing laboratory testing and analysis
   • Offering semi-finished customized pre-mixed cement

   • Transferring CSA production technology


Need more info?


Contact us today to learn more about the future CSA cement and how it can benefit your business in
the future.

What is CSA and who is Cementsy?

 

Cementsy is a leading manufacturer of Calcium Sulfoaluminate* (CSA) cement, a specialty cement known
for its fast-setting, high early and final strength, shrinkage compensation, and long-term
resistance to freeze-thaw, seepage, sulfate, chloride, Mg²⁺, and efflorescence. Modern CSA cement
was first developed and commercialized by the China Building Materials Academy in the 1980s. Its
exceptional performance has been well-established for over 40 years.


A team of scientists and engineers, with decades of experience in CSA technology, founded Cementsy
with the goal of providing global customers with the highest quality and most advanced CSA products.
The company supplies a wide range of CSA-related solutions to meet the needs of customers of all
sizes and specializations.


Common applications where Cementsy CSA provide substantial benefits are:


   • Rapid Concrete Repair
   • Self-Leveling Mortar
   • Self-Compacting Concrete
   • Precast and Prestressed Concrete
   • Rapid Demolding Concrete
   • Fiber Reinforced Concrete
   • Decorative Concrete
   • Shotcrete and Gunite
   • Mining and Tunneling Support
   • Coating Mortar
   • Waterproofing Mortar
   • Hydraulic Cement
   • Tile Adhesive
   • Tile Grout
   • Anchoring Grout
   • Pressure and Compacting Grout
   • Soil Stabilization
   • 3D Concrete Printing
   • Time-Sensitive Project
   • Low-Temperature Project
   • Coastal and Undersea Project

   • Portland Cement Accelerator

   • General Crack Prevention

   • Jointless Long-Span Concrete


* Also known as Calcium Sulphoaluminate


Our mission

 

At Cementsy, our mission is to increase recognition and understanding of CSA cement globally, making
it a more widely used and appreciated material in the industry and contributing to a more
sustainable future.

 

As a cement produced with 35% lower CO₂ emissions, CSA cement offers numerous performance advantages
over OPC and other Alternative Cementitious Materials (ACMs). However, despite these advantages and
its long service life, CSA cement is not widely used due to a lack of understanding in the global
market about its properties. Confusion often arises from the similarities between CSA ground
clinker, CSA binder, CSA cement, and Calcium Aluminate Cement (CAC). To address these challenges,
Cementsy partners with one of the largest CSA research institutes to spread knowledge about the
latest research and promote the global use of CSA cement.

 

Our specialties

 

Cementsy offers a variety of CSA-related products to serve customers of all sizes, including:

   • CSA Ground Clinker (CSA Binder)

   • CSA Cement

   • CSA Expansive Additive

   • CSA-Based Mortar

   • Specialized Additives and Auxiliaries for CSA Products


At Cementsy, we also offer comprehensive technical support to all of our customers, covering a range
of services, such as:

   • Reviewing formulas
   • Recommending material selection
   • Providing technical and design consultation
   • Performing laboratory testing and analysis
   • Offering semi-finished customized pre-mixed cement

   • Transferring CSA production technology


Need more info?


Contact us today to learn more about the future CSA cement and how it can benefit your business in
the future.

## Frequently Asked Questions

Common questions about CheckerTR PRO Android service software and licensing.

### What is CheckerTR PRO?

CheckerTR PRO is an all-in-one GSM repair toolkit for professional technicians. It covers IMEI
repair, FRP bypass, data recovery, and flashing for most Android brands.

### Which brands are supported?

We support Samsung, Xiaomi, MediaTek, Qualcomm, Huawei, Oppo, Realme, Infinix, Tecno, and many other
brands with dedicated service modules.

Licenses and credits are sold through our official reseller network. Check our [Authorized

## Commonly Asked Questions

What is computer system assurance?

Computer Software Assurance (CSA) is a testing process. This form of testing is limited to functions
directly impacting patient safety and product quality. CSA is typically used for high-risk
activities only. Each element of the software is tested thoroughly.

What is the purpose of software validation?

Software validation ensures that the software meets the specified and pre-defined business
requirements. This process evaluates the software product and ensures that it meets the demands of
end-users or customers.

What is the purpose of 21 CFR Part 11?

21 CFR Part 11 is a Code of Federal Regulation that is relevant across various industries. 21 CFR
Part 11 details the criteria that applies to electronic signatures and records that are considered
to be trustworthy.

directly impacting patient safety and product quality. CSA is typically used for high-risk
activities only. Each element of the software is tested thoroughly.

What is the purpose of software validation?

Software validation ensures that the software meets the specified and pre-defined business
requirements. This process evaluates the software product and ensures that it meets the demands of
end-users or customers.

What is the purpose of 21 CFR Part 11?

21 CFR Part 11 is a Code of Federal Regulation that is relevant across various industries. 21 CFR
Part 11 details the criteria that applies to electronic signatures and records that are considered
to be trustworthy.

# See what your competitors
# will do next.

While others chase press releases and earnings calls, we capture real intelligence from the data
trails companies leave behind unknowingly — whether competitors, acquisition targets, potential
partners, or emerging disruptors.

Book a Demo
[Watch the Walkthrough][7]
[From digital exhaust to predictions]

## Trusted by teams at

[Intuit][S2A][Eleventh Hour Group][Abridge]
The Problem

## Why traditional intelligence falls short
* Curated narrativePress releases, earnings calls, official announcements — that's the story
  companies want you to see. By the time something is announced, it's too late to respond
  strategically. You're reacting, not planning.
* Commoditized sourcesTraditional market intelligence pulls from the same obvious sources everyone
  else uses. If you're reading it, so are your competitors.
* Data without contextTraditional tools bombard you with notifications — a job posting here, a doc
  update there. You spend hours trying to figure out what matters. You have alerts, not answers.

How it works

## From digital exhaust to predictions

Each step compresses the input. Thousands of raw signals collapse into a handful of patterns, then
into a single forecast you can act on.
* Digital exhaust
  LinkedIn activity
  Job descriptions
  API documentation
  Web & copy changes
  Reddit threads
  + 19 more source types
  CaptureWe monitor the unintentional data trails companies leave behind — job descriptions

  updates and more. Intelligence they never meant to share.
  Signals
  Hiring
  Field sales push
  12 AE roles, 3 metros

  Endpoints + docs added
  SynthesizeA single job post or pricing page tweak is noise. Hundreds, woven together, become
  patterns. We connect signals across sources — hiring spikes, doc changes, ad shifts, partnership
  chatter — to surface the combinations that actually mean something.
  Predictions
  Forecast
  Mid-market
  enterprise launch
  Hiring, product, and brand signals align one direction.
  Within 60 days
  High confidence
  PredictFrom the patterns, we forecast what's coming next — product launches, market entries,
  acquisitions, organizational pivots — each with a time horizon and confidence score. You see the
  move before it's made, not after the press release.

compute on a schedule instead of running it until it breaks.

Buying Guides/July 21, 2026

#### Turning a Rack Power Fleet From Blind to Observable

Most rack and closet outages start as a blind spot, not a failure — a circuit nobody was watching, a
battery nobody polled, an outlet nobody could reach remotely. Here is the upgrade path from a basic
power strip to a fleet you can meter, alert on, and reboot from anywhere.

][27][
Buying Guides/July 21, 2026

#### The Hardware Behind a Backup Ransomware Can't Encrypt

Attackers delete or encrypt backups before they ever trigger the ransom note. Here is the storage
hardware — immutable, air-gapped, and separate from what you restore into — built to survive that
step.

][28][
Industry Trends/July 21, 2026

#### Your EDR Is Only as Strong as the Silicon Under It

Behavior-based EDR and XDR read telemetry from an operating system that assumes its own boot chain
is honest — an assumption detection software is rarely built to verify. TPM 2.0, secure boot, and
hardware-based manageability are the prerequisites that let that assumption hold, and most Windows
11 refresh purchases are already paying for them.

### Gabriel Gugliemli

**Vice President, Product Management**

In the role of Vice President of Product Management, Gabriel Guglielmi oversees all product
management for Infinite Electronics’ global operations.

Gabriel brings more than 25 years of experience in the electronics components industry, serving in
various senior management positions including General Manger at ST Microelectronics, Vice President
of Business Development and Strategy at Smiths Connectors, and President of Interconnect Devices Inc
(IDI). His leadership and product line management experience drove growth within these companies by
focusing on developing and expanding product portfolios through internal product development and
private labeling.

Gabriel has a Bachelor of Science degree in Mechanical Engineering from INSA in Lyon, France, and a
Master’s degree in Strategic Management from HEC in Paris, France.

### Penny Cotner

**President and Chief Executive Officer

**

As Infinite Electronics’ President and Chief Executive Officer, Penny leads the executive management
team to drive growth and shareholder value.

Penny joined Infinite in 2013, and brings over 25 years of experience in the Electronics industry,
from engineering positions at Hughes Aircraft Company and with Rockwell’s Space Station Program, to
leadership roles in Marketing and Sales Operations with Fortune 500 global Electronics Distributor,
Arrow Electronics.

Penny holds a B.S. in Electrical Engineering from California State – Northridge and an M.B.A. from
UC – Irvine.

### Jason Koshy

**Vice President, Global Sales**

As Infinite Electronics’ Global VP of Sales, Jason leads all sales teams, including Inside Sales &
Service, Channel Sales and Installations.

Jason has more than 22 years of experience that covers all facets of the business, with past
positions including Applications Engineer, Quality & Manufacturing Engineer, Regional Sales Manager,
Director of Sales for North America and, most recently, VP of Sales for the Americas and ROW. Jason
also participated in the integration of Kaelus, RadioWaves, PolyPhaser and Transtector into the
Infinite Electronics brand family.

Jason holds a Bachelor of Science in Electrical Engineering from the University of South Florida.

### Krishnan Iyer

**Vice President, Information Technology**

In the role of VP of Information Technology, Krishnan oversees all IT functions for Infinite
Electronics’ global operations.

Krishnan has more than 30 years of broad-based technology experience in a variety of industries that
encompass both publicly traded and privately held organizations, including Conexant, Capital Group
and Schneider Electric. Krishnan’s experiences within these enterprises fostered multiple
partnerships across varied functional areas, highlighting his ability to provide sound technology
solutions that solve internal and external customers’ business issues.

Krishnan earned an MBA from Pepperdine University, a Master of Science degree in Computer Science
from the Florida Institute of Technology, and Bachelor of Science degrees in Physics and
Mathematics.

### Brian McCutcheon

**Vice President, Operations **

Brian is Infinite’s Vice President of Operations, leading the management team responsible for six of
Infinite Electronics’ logistics and productions facilities. His efforts focus on being an
operational change agent for the transformation and integration of key business systems and
processes.

Brian’s experience spans the scope of operations and business management functions. Prior to joining
Infinite Electronics, Brian worked at two Fortune 500 companies. During his 15 years with Nokia, he
held multiple management-level positions, including, Production Manager for its US-based, network
equipment factory and Program Manager for carrier acceptance of network infrastructure installations
and mobile device launches. While with Halliburton for nearly five years, he worked as an industrial
engineer and was selected to participate in the company’s Management Training Program.

Brian has an Executive MBA from SMU Cox School of Business, and a Bachelor of Science degree in
Industrial Engineering from Texas A&M University.

### Scott Rosner

**Chief Financial Officer**

As CFO, Scott is responsible for Infinite Electronics’ global Accounting, Finance, Information
Technology and M&A diligence functions.

Scott comes to Infinite Electronics with more than 25 years of accounting, finance, IT and HR
experience, leading organizations such as Anchor Blue, APX Logistics, and the publicly traded
House2Home/HomeBase. Scott’s most recent role was with CoolSys, Inc, where he was CFO.

Scott holds a B.A. in Accounting and an M.B.A. from Cal State Fullerton.

### Jim Dauw

**Chief Operating Officer **

As COO, Jim is responsible for Infinite Electronics’ global operations strategy, implementation and
facilities management.

Jim’s expertise includes more than 25 years of strategic and operational experience, leading global
fortune 500 organizations such as ITT, GKN and Alcoa. Jim’s most recent role was with 3V Fasteners,
where he was the President. Jim’s experience spans the scope of operations and business management
functions.

Jim holds a B.A. in History from Michigan State University and an M.B.A. from Pepperdine University.

### Frank Shambarger

**Vice President, Human Resources **

Frank is responsible for Infinite Electronics’ global human resources operations, leading
organizational strategy, promoting operational effectiveness, and building a positive working
culture.

With over 20 years of human resource management experience, Frank brings expertise in implementing
change at all levels of a global, complex and dynamic organization, using human resource
technologies to enhance bottom line results.

Prior to his tenure with Infinite Electronics, Frank held senior human resources roles at WEX Inc.,
Amistco Separation Products, Munters, M/A-COM and Tyco Electronics.

Frank holds a B.S. in Business Administration from the University of New Hampshire, and has studied
Advanced Human Resource Management at the University of California, Los Angeles – Anderson School of
Management.

overarching marketing initiatives to grow the business.

Laurie comes to Infinite with over 25 years of experience in the industrial electronic co

### Gabriel Gugliemli

**Vice President, Product Management**

In the role of Vice President of Product Management, Gabriel Guglielmi oversees all product
management for Infinite Electronics’ global operations.

Gabriel brings more than 25 years of experience in the electronics components industry, serving in
various senior management positions including General Manger at ST Microelectronics, Vice President
of Business Development and Strategy at Smiths Connectors, and President of Interconnect Devices Inc
(IDI). His leadership and product line management experience drove growth within these companies by
focusing on developing and expanding product portfolios through internal product development and
private labeling.

Gabriel has a Bachelor of Science degree in Mechanical Engineering from INSA in Lyon, France, and a
Master’s degree in Strategic Management from HEC in Paris, France.

### Penny Cotner

**President and Chief Executive Officer

**

As Infinite Electronics’ President and Chief Executive Officer, Penny leads the executive management
team to drive growth and shareholder value.

Penny joined Infinite in 2013, and brings over 25 years of experience in the Electronics industry,
from engineering positions at Hughes Aircraft Company and with Rockwell’s Space Station Program, to
leadership roles in Marketing and Sales Operations with Fortune 500 global Electronics Distributor,
Arrow Electronics.

Penny holds a B.S. in Electrical Engineering from California State – Northridge and an M.B.A. from
UC – Irvine.

### Jason Koshy

**Vice President, Global Sales**

As Infinite Electronics’ Global VP of Sales, Jason leads all sales teams, including Inside Sales &
Service, Channel Sales and Installations.

Jason has more than 22 years of experience that covers all facets of the business, with past
positions including Applications Engineer, Quality & Manufacturing Engineer, Regional Sales Manager,
Director of Sales for North America and, most recently, VP of Sales for the Americas and ROW. Jason
also participated in the integration of Kaelus, RadioWaves, PolyPhaser and Transtector into the
Infinite Electronics brand family.

Jason holds a Bachelor of Science in Electrical Engineering from the University of South Florida.

### Krishnan Iyer

**Vice President, Information Technology**

In the role of VP of Information Technology, Krishnan oversees all IT functions for Infinite
Electronics’ global operations.

Krishnan has more than 30 years of broad-based technology experience in a variety of industries that
encompass both publicly traded and privately held organizations, including Conexant, Capital Group
and Schneider Electric. Krishnan’s experiences within these enterprises fostered multiple
partnerships across varied functional areas, highlighting his ability to provide sound technology
solutions that solve internal and external customers’ business issues.

Krishnan earned an MBA from Pepperdine University, a Master of Science degree in Computer Science
from the Florida Institute of Technology, and Bachelor of Science degrees in Physics and
Mathematics.

### Brian McCutcheon

**Vice President, Operations **

Brian is Infinite’s Vice President of Operations, leading the management team responsible for six of
Infinite Electronics’ logistics and productions facilities. His efforts focus on being an
operational change agent for the transformation and integration of key business systems and
processes.

Brian’s experience spans the scope of operations and business management functions. Prior to joining
Infinite Electronics, Brian worked at two Fortune 500 companies. During his 15 years with Nokia, he
held multiple management-level positions, including, Production Manager for its US-based, network
equipment factory and Program Manager for carrier acceptance of network infrastructure installations
and mobile device launches. While with Halliburton for nearly five years, he worked as an industrial
engineer and was selected to participate in the company’s Management Training Program.

Brian has an Executive MBA from SMU Cox School of Business, and a Bachelor of Science degree in
Industrial Engineering from Texas A&M University.

### Scott Rosner

**Chief Financial Officer**

As CFO, Scott is responsible for Infinite Electronics’ global Accounting, Finance, Information
Technology and M&A diligence functions.

Scott comes to Infinite Electronics with more than 25 years of accounting, finance, IT and HR
experience, leading organizations such as Anchor Blue, APX Logistics, and the publicly traded
House2Home/HomeBase. Scott’s most recent role was with CoolSys, Inc, where he was CFO.

Scott holds a B.A. in Accounting and an M.B.A. from Cal State Fullerton.

### Jim Dauw

**Chief Operating Officer **

As COO, Jim is responsible for Infinite Electronics’ global operations strategy, implementation and
facilities management.

Jim’s expertise includes more than 25 years of strategic and operational experience, leading global
fortune 500 organizations such as ITT, GKN and Alcoa. Jim’s most recent role was with 3V Fasteners,
where he was the President. Jim’s experience spans the scope of operations and business management
functions.

Jim holds a B.A. in History from Michigan State University and an M.B.A. from Pepperdine University.

### Frank Shambarger

**Vice President, Human Resources **

Frank is responsible for Infinite Electronics’ global human resources operations, leading
organizational strategy, promoting operational effectiveness, and building a positive working
culture.

With over 20 years of human resource management experience, Frank brings expertise in implementing
change at all levels of a global, complex and dynamic organization, using human resource
technologies to enhance bottom line results.

Prior to his tenure with Infinite Electronics, Frank held senior human resources roles at WEX Inc.,
Amistco Separation Products, Munters, M/A-COM and Tyco Electronics.

Frank holds a B.S. in Business Administration from the University of New Hampshire, and has studied
Advanced Human Resource Management at the University of California, Los Angeles – Anderson School of
Management.

Laurie comes to Infinite with over 25 years of experience in the industrial electronic co

Lean Biologix is a unique service provider for regulated manufacturers. We leverage a combination of
current technology and lean principles to deliver efficient and manageable solutions. Our close
integration with your internal resources lets us fully understand your problems to provide
sustainable process improvements that have a lasting impact.

 

### Learn how we apply these principles to your next project.

# Operational Excellence for Life Science Manufacturers

 

 

Lean Biologix is a unique service provider for regulated manufacturers. We leverage a combination of
current technology and lean principles to deliver efficient and manageable solutions. Our close
integration with your internal resources lets us fully understand your problems to provide
sustainable process improvements that have a lasting impact.

 

### Learn how we apply these principles to your next project.

[Let's Get Started][31]

## Whitepaper:
## Evaluation of Shipping System Qualification Data

#### The Lean Process

Learn and apply industry best practices within your qualification processes to evaluate
qualification data provided by thermal shipping system manufacturers and vendors. Leveraging
pre-existing qualification packages is a tremendous time and resource.

[Learn More][32]

continuous communication and time management skills.

## What is Cloud Based GST, Billing & Accounting Software?

A cloud based billing software allows business to handle all their invoicing, keep tabs on payments,
and securely manage their financial information on the internet. With 32+ years of expertise,
trusted by over 10+ million businesses across every trade. Our cloud-based GST, billing & accounting
software keeps invoicing easy, data secure, and finances accurate anytime, anywhere.

Traditional billing software cannot offer this, yet cloud-based systems mean everyone on a team,
including the accountant and business owner, can work on the same materials from remotely connected
devices. Because financial processes can be shifted easily, dependency on paperwork is minimized.
Most accounting software includes the main accounting functions (ledgers, collecting payments, and
matching banks) together with features for invoicing (automatic, repeating, and reminders).

It is particularly good for companies that want to manage their cash flow easily and ensure their
books are accurate. Many billing software with GST, the updated dashboards and reporting, managers
have all the necessary information for fast and smart actions to help the business. Another main
benefit is that cloud based accounting software is designed to protect your data. Thanks to their
advanced security features, your information on these platforms is safe and relatively hard to
access by unauthorized users. This means users do not need to update the software on their own,
since changes are done automatically.

The purpose of GST billing software is to help Indian companies prepare GST-compliant invoices. It
simplifies calculating taxes, sets the correct GST rates, and makes GST invoices with important
details such as HSN/SAC codes, the organization’s GSTIN, and all tax details. Furthermore, using
[billing software][95] free lowers the chance of errors and provides automatic assistance during
returns, making the GSTR reports, managing audit records, and quickly matching data with government
platforms.

### Unsere Vorteile

Die Opture [Risikomanagement Software][73] ist intuitiv bedienbar, flexibel konfigurierbar, modular
erweiterbar und einfach administrierbar. Unsere Kunden schätzen insbesondere das einfache operative
Handling der Software, wodurch die Akzeptanz der Risikoverantwortlichen und dezentralen
Risikomanager sehr hoch ist.

Die Oberfläche der Opture [Risikomanagement Software][74] kann individuell an die Wünsche der
User/Anwender angepasst werden. Damit wird sichergestellt, dass unterschiedliche Anforderungen der
User abgebildet werden können. So möchte beispielsweise der zentrale Risikomanager sehr vielfältige
Funktionalitäten in der Software zur Verfügung haben (z.B. für Analysefähigkeiten, Risiko Monitoring
und [Risiko Reporting][75]) im Gegensatz zum Risikoverantwortlichen, der häufig nur so wenig
Eingaben wie möglich/nötig vornehmen möchte.

[Lesen Sie mehr ][76]

#### Risikoberichte

Die Opture Software stellt seinen Anwendern standardisierte und individuell konfigurierbare
[Risikoberichte][77] zur Verfügung. Alle Risikoberichte können auf Knopfdruck, vollständig
automatisch, aktualisiert und ausgedruckt werden. Somit kann der Risikomanager, oder andere
berechtigte Anwender, bei kurzfristigen Anfragen, z.B. durch die Geschäftsleitung, sofort
vollständig aktualisierte Risikoberichte für unterschiedliche Adressaten einfach generieren und
ausdrucken.

Der Anwender kann individuelle Risikoberichtsvorlagen in die Opture [Risikomanagement Software][78]
hochladen, z.B. in Form einer Executive Summary (Fliesstext) oder einer Präsentation (Charts). In
alle Vorlagen/Templates werden die aktuellen Daten eingelesen und aktualisiert. Die vorhandenen
Graphiken und Texte ändern sich entsprechend dem veränderten Dateninput. Selbstverständlich können
die Risikoberichte auch im Nachhinein noch modifiziert und angepasst werden.

[Lesen Sie mehr ][79]

#### Marktführerschaft

Die [OPTURE AG][80] ist einer der führenden Anbieter für [Risikomanagement Softwarelösungen][81] für
Industrieunternehmen in Europa. Mit unseren Kunden sind wir in über 80 Ländern vertreten mit
Niederlassungen in Zürich (Schweiz), Hamburg (Deutschland) und London (England).

Wir sind mit unseren Softwarelösungen auf das Thema [Risikomanagement][82] spezialisiert,
insbesondere bei Industrieunternehmen. Wir beliefern sowohl Klein- und Mittelstandsunternehmen aus
einer Vielzahl von Branchen, als auch internationale Grosskonzerne und DAX-/SMI-/Nasdaq-Unternehmen.

Die OPTURE AG ist seit Jahren Technologieführer, z.B. in den Bereichen [Risikoaggregation][83],
[Monte Carlo Simulation][84], [Modellierung][85], [Risk Profiling][86], und [Simulationsbasierte
Planung][87], ...

[Lesen Sie mehr ][88]

#### Preisvorteile

Die [Opture "Basic" Version][89] ist eine Standardanwendung, die am Markt bereits seit dem Jahr 2005
etabliert ist und permanent weiterentwickelt wird. Die Software läuft extrem stabil und erfüllt alle
nationalen und internationalen regulatorischen Anforderungen, Richtlinien und Standards. Sie bildet
den kompletten Risikomanagement Prozess ab (Identifikation der Risiken/Chancen/Massnahmen,
Bewertung, Analyse, Steuerung, Monitoring, Reporting).

Die Opture "Basic" Version ist eine [Risikomanagement Software][90] für Einsteiger oder für
Anwender, die von einem bestehenden Excel-Tool zu einer Webanwendung wechseln möchten. Diese Version
kann mit einer Vielzahl von Modulen sukzessive erweitert werden. Diese Basisvariante wird zu extrem
wettbewerbsfähigen Preisen angeboten.

[Lesen Sie mehr ][91]

#### Risikomanagement Know How

Die [OPTURE AG][92] wurde ursprünglich als Spin-off Unternehmen der Firma Noetzold & Noetzold GmbH
gegründet, ein auch auf [Risikomanagement][93] spezialisiert Beratungsunternehmen. Die Mitarbeiter
der OPTURE AG sind erfahrene und seniore Experten im Bereich Risikomanagement. Alle unsere
Mitarbeiter waren vor ihrem Eintritt in die OPTURE AG bereits als Führungskräfte in anderen
Unternehmen tätig.

Das theoretische Know How unserer Mitarbeiter wird durch ihre praktischen Erfahrungen ergänzt.
Aufgrund der hohen Anzahl unserer Kunden im [Risikomanagement][94] haben unsere Mitarbeiter
Kenntnisse über spezifische Fragestellungen und deren Lösungsansätze in verschiedenen Marktsegmenten
und Branchen.

ausdrucken.

Der Anwender kann individuelle Risikoberichtsvorlagen in die Opture [Risikomanagement Software][78]

alle Vorlagen/Templates werden die aktuellen Daten eingelesen und aktualisiert. Die vorhandenen
Graphiken und Texte ändern sich entsprechend dem veränderten Dateninput. Selbstverständlich können
die Risikoberichte auch im Nachhinein noch modifiziert und angepasst werden.

Standard LLM agents guess answers by querying raw, unsorted search results, leading to
hallucinations. Polaris7 agents operate on a validated knowledge graph, delivering facts you can
trust.

relationships, competition and strategic movement.

digital platforms. By structuring these highly fragmented markets, Polaris7 helps teams understand
not just who the players are, but how they actually connect and compete.

The value is not in seeing more companies. The value is in understanding the right companies in the
right context.

Turn fragmented market movements into resolved, structured deliverables in minutes. Polaris7 agents

#### Acquisition Target Lists

Identify target companies based on capability gaps, category overlaps, and strategic positioning.

## Go beyond data: understand strategy

Polaris7 does not just show companies and competitors.

It helps you understand:

### Positioning

Understand exactly how companies are positioned within the market landscape.

### Capabilities

Map out the products, infrastructure, and technology they actually provide.

constraints. Polaris7 combines deep domain expertise in advertising, media, and digital platforms
with expert-grounded AI to provide strategic intelligence that actually understands industry
mechanics.

Standard LLM agents guess answers by querying raw Google results. They confuse parent holdings with

resolved, curated knowledge graph, delivering answers grounded in verified, real-world
relationships.

critical signals are scattered across news, websites, and code. Traditional search and raw AI agents
cannot navigate this complexity without structure.

programmatic integrations to reveal the system architecture.

shifts as they unfold across the web.

Standard LLM agents guess answers by querying raw, unsorted search results, leading to
hallucinations. Polaris7 agents operate on a validated knowledge graph, delivering facts you can
trust.

Home Page[Scott Licata][27]2026-07-13T10:05:50-04:00

### About Us

SAFECode is a global nonprofit organization that brings business leaders and technical experts
together to exchange insights and ideas on creating, improving and promoting scalable and effective
software security programs.

[JOIN THE COLLABORATION][28]

### Recent Blog Posts

[

## What About the Role of AI? Updated Guidance on Secure by Design

][29]

CIS and SAFECode have now released Version 1.1 of the Secure by Design guide and spreadsheet. The
new guide includes more specific guidance on AI and software security, is consistent in content with
the new ETSI standard, and corrects the errors that have been discovered since the release of
original version.

[Read More][30]
[

## A New International Standard for Software Security

][31]

Last fall, SAFECode partnered with the Center for Internet Security (CIS) to create a guide to
“Security by Design” that provides development organizations with actionable guidance on creating
secure software and meeting the requirements of the NIST Secure Software Development Framework
(SSDF).

[Read More][32]

### Software Security Resources

Secure software development can only be achieved with an organizational commitment to the successful
execution of a holistic software security process. Learn more about key elements of an effective
software security program in our Resource Centers.

together to exchange insights and ideas on creating, improving and promoting scalable and effective
software security programs.

[

## What About the Role of AI? Updated Guidance on Secure by Design

][29]

CIS and SAFECode have now released Version 1.1 of the Secure by Design guide and spreadsheet. The
new guide includes more specific guidance on AI and software security, is consistent in content with
the new ETSI standard, and corrects the errors that have been discovered since the release of
original version.

[Read More][30]
[

## A New International Standard for Software Security

][31]

Last fall, SAFECode partnered with the Center for Internet Security (CIS) to create a guide to
“Security by Design” that provides development organizations with actionable guidance on creating
secure software and meeting the requirements of the NIST Secure Software Development Framework
(SSDF).

[Read More][32]

## Thermoplastic Hoses Manufacturer Since 1979

#### High-performance Solutions for Hydraulic, Industrial, and UHP Applications

Transfer Oil is a leading Italian manufacturer of reinforced thermoplastic hoses, fittings and hose
assemblies engineered for demanding applications. Since 1979, we have specialized in the design,
production, and testing of high-pressure hoses – with applications ranging from hydraulic systems to
industrial fluid and gas conveying, as well as ultra high-pressure (UHP) equipment.
 
Committed from the beginning to the highest standards of quality and performance, Transfer Oil was
one of the first companies in the industry to achieve **UNI EN ISO 9001** certification in 1993.
Today, our products hold globally recognized third-party certifications and approvals from
organizations such as **DNV** (Det Norske Veritas), **ABS** (American Bureau of Shipping), **MSHA**
(Mine Safety and Health Administration), and **CSA** (Canadian Standards Association).
 
Our comprehensive product portfolio is the result of continuous research and development, offering
solutions tailored to meet the needs of the most demanding industries. The **TO Hydraulic** range
includes **SAE 100 R7** and **SAE 100 R8** hoses with polyurethane covers, **MSHA-approved**, for
enhanced abrasion resistance and very low volumetric expansion for precise operation in tough
conditions.
 
Expanding our technology into new markets, the **Fuel line within our TO Industrial range** supports
the global transition to low-carbon mobility by offering specific thermoplastic hose solutions for
clean refueling applications. We supply **CSA-certified** CNG hoses and hydrogen hoses both
engineered for low permeability and ease of handling to ensure fast and safe refueling. Designed to
meet the requirements of modern hydrogen infrastructure, our H2 hoses meet test requirements of
**ISO 19880-5 **and are reinforced with steel and aramid fibers to withstand pressures up to 1.040
bar (15,000 psi).
 
For **extreme pressure applications**, our proprietary **Helix® hose line **– launched in 2015 –
provides performance from 690 bar (10,000 psi) to 3.800 bar (55,000 psi), ensuring safety and
durability in critical operations such as **hydro-demolition, water jetting, bolt tensioning, heat
exchanger cleaning and pressure testing**. All Helix® assemblies are provided as factory-made
assemblies only, to guarantee full compatibility and compliance with the most stringent industry
standards.
 
With over four decades of experience, state-of-the-art facilities, and full control of every
production stage – from raw materials to 100% final testing – Transfer Oil delivers thermoplastic
hoses that combine **innovation, quality, and performance**, serving customers in more than 75
countries worldwide.

## Thermoplastic Hoses Manufacturer Since 1979

#### High-performance Solutions for Hydraulic, Industrial, and UHP Applications

Transfer Oil is a leading Italian manufacturer of reinforced thermoplastic hoses, fittings and hose
assemblies engineered for demanding applications. Since 1979, we have specialized in the design,
production, and testing of high-pressure hoses – with applications ranging from hydraulic systems to
industrial fluid and gas conveying, as well as ultra high-pressure (UHP) equipment.
 
Committed from the beginning to the highest standards of quality and performance, Transfer Oil was
one of the first companies in the industry to achieve **UNI EN ISO 9001** certification in 1993.
Today, our products hold globally recognized third-party certifications and approvals from
organizations such as **DNV** (Det Norske Veritas), **ABS** (American Bureau of Shipping), **MSHA**
(Mine Safety and Health Administration), and **CSA** (Canadian Standards Association).
 
Our comprehensive product portfolio is the result of continuous research and development, offering
solutions tailored to meet the needs of the most demanding industries. The **TO Hydraulic** range
includes **SAE 100 R7** and **SAE 100 R8** hoses with polyurethane covers, **MSHA-approved**, for
enhanced abrasion resistance and very low volumetric expansion for precise operation in tough
conditions.
 
Expanding our technology into new markets, the **Fuel line within our TO Industrial range** supports
the global transition to low-carbon mobility by offering specific thermoplastic hose solutions for
clean refueling applications. We supply **CSA-certified** CNG hoses and hydrogen hoses both
engineered for low permeability and ease of handling to ensure fast and safe refueling. Designed to
meet the requirements of modern hydrogen infrastructure, our H2 hoses meet test requirements of
**ISO 19880-5 **and are reinforced with steel and aramid fibers to withstand pressures up to 1.040
bar (15,000 psi).
 
For **extreme pressure applications**, our proprietary **Helix® hose line **– launched in 2015 –
provides performance from 690 bar (10,000 psi) to 3.800 bar (55,000 psi), ensuring safety and
durability in critical operations such as **hydro-demolition, water jetting, bolt tensioning, heat
exchanger cleaning and pressure testing**. All Helix® assemblies are provided as factory-made
assemblies only, to guarantee full compatibility and compliance with the most stringent industry
standards.
 
With over four decades of experience, state-of-the-art facilities, and full control of every
production stage – from raw materials to 100% final testing – Transfer Oil delivers thermoplastic
hoses that combine **innovation, quality, and performance**, serving customers in more than 75
countries worldwide.

Why does **Wholesalers Network** offer this directory of wholesale companies for free?
We’re glad you asked. We understand that starting and running a business is hard work. It costs a
lot of money to design, build and promote a new website. With all the costs involved with running a
retail store, eBay or e-commerce business we wanted to provide you with a free directory of
wholesale merchandise and products. We’ve also operated online retail stores and know how
challenging it can be to find the right wholesaler.

## Wholesale sourcing and the evolving digital marketplace

Platforms like Wholesalers Network provide businesses with structured access to thousands of
suppliers across multiple categories, making it easier to discover products for both online and
offline sales. Such directories play an important role in the B2B ecosystem by helping entrepreneurs
and retailers connect with manufacturers, distributors, and dropshipping partners in a more
efficient way.

In wholesale commerce, success depends heavily on reliable sourcing, consistent supply chains, and
strong supplier relationships. Businesses that take the time to evaluate partners, compare pricing
structures, and test product quality are better positioned to scale sustainably and maintain healthy
profit margins over time.

For a deeper look at how buyers can verify credibility before they commit money or time, read [Trust
Signals in B2B Wholesale Sourcing vs New Online Casinos][144].

Within this broader ecosystem, platforms such as **[casinoer uden rofus][145]** reflect how diverse
online experiences have become, offering users additional ways to engage and relax during their free
time.

As the digital marketplace continues to expand, B2B platforms are becoming more than just
directories—they are evolving into ecosystems where information, logistics, and communication
intersect. This transformation allows businesses to operate more efficiently and adapt to changing
market demands with greater flexibility.

At the same time, the online environment is not limited to business and sourcing alone. Users
interact with a wide variety of platforms daily, combining work-related activities with
entertainment and leisure in a single digital space.

Ultimately, building a successful wholesale business requires a combination of smart sourcing
strategies, adaptability, and balance. By leveraging reliable directories while staying open to
broader digital trends, businesses can create sustainable growth in an increasingly connected world.

Do you list [wholesale dropship companies][146] on this website?
Yes. All companies that offer drop shipping are linked to the “[Dropshipper][147]” page of the
directory. See our article on dropshipping or eBay wholesalers for more information.

We also list wholesale distributors, manufacturers of products, trade only, end of line and closeout
merchandise, liquidators, distribution networks, b2b news, wholesale suppliers, importers,
exporters, transport, and logistics companies.

As digital markets continue to evolve, many businesses are looking beyond traditional wholesale and
retail models to identify new growth opportunities. The expansion of online ecosystems has created
entirely new sectors where partnerships, scalability, and global reach are essential components of
success.

In addition to physical goods and logistics networks, digital platforms now play a significant role
in shaping modern commerce. From subscription-based services to entertainment-driven platforms, the
structure of these industries often mirrors wholesale principles — connecting suppliers with end
users through efficient and scalable systems.

A notable example of this shift can be seen in the growth of international online entertainment
platforms. Concepts such as **[Online Casino utan spelpaus][148]** highlight how digital services
are expanding across borders, offering users alternative experiences while relying on strong backend
infrastructure, marketing strategies, and user acquisition models.

For entrepreneurs and business owners, understanding these parallel industries can provide valuable
insights into customer behavior, digital scaling strategies, and emerging global trends. Exploring
how different sectors operate can ultimately help businesses remain competitive and adaptable in an
increasingly interconnected marketplace.

intersect. This transformation allows businesses to operate more efficiently and adapt to changing

entertainment and leisure in a single digital space.

Waarom Zenya?

## Minder zorgen. Meer tijd voor zorg. Dat is Zenya.

De zorg verandert continu. Wij groeien sinds 1998 met haar mee. Wat begon als een manier om
informatie in één ziekenhuis beter te organiseren, werd een missie om de zorg slimmer, veiliger en
menselijker te maken. **Vandaag ondersteunt Zenya meer dan 450 zorgorganisaties, van bijna alle
ziekenhuizen in Nederland en Vlaanderen tot gespecialiseerde zorgorganisaties en
netwerkorganisaties.** 

Zenya is niet meer weg te denken uit de zorg. En de zorg niet uit ons DNA. Samen met onze klanten
werken we elke dag aan hetzelfde doel: zorg die continu beter wordt.

De zorg verandert continu. Wij groeien sinds 1998 met haar mee. Wat begon als een manier om
informatie in één ziekenhuis beter te organiseren, werd een missie om de zorg slimmer, veiliger en

ziekenhuizen in Nederland en Vlaanderen tot gespecialiseerde zorgorganisaties en
netwerkorganisaties.** 

Zenya is niet meer weg te denken uit de zorg. En de zorg niet uit ons DNA. Samen met onze klanten
